Most Indians are disciplined investors. Over the years, they've built real wealth in their mutual funds and stock portfolios. But when a financial need comes up — a medical bill, a business opportunity, a child's college fees — that wealth suddenly feels out of reach. At Quicklend, we believe your investments should do two things at once: grow for your future and work for your present. We're building India's secured lending stack, starting with loans against mutual funds (LAMF) and loans against shares (LAS): products that let you borrow against the wealth you've already built, without selling a single unit. You get the liquidity you need, at rates significantly lower than personal loans, with a process that takes minutes, not days. We're based in Bengaluru and just getting started. If you're an investor, mutual fund distributor (MFD) / wealth advisor, or an NBFC keen on launching secured credit products, we'd love to connect.

Omicsveu is driven to harness and accelerate multiplex multi-omics Spatial Biology research. We deliver the most innovative, powerful biomedical tools that fuel Spatial Biology discoveries, and meet other life science challenges of today. Our Fully automated & integrated systems are affordable, simpler, and easy to use, faster to help accelerate precession oncology research, reduce cost, improve disease outcome, and enhance patient quality of life. Omicsveu offers fully automated ready-to-use integrated systems which include Phenoveu, RNAveu, miRNAveu, Genotyping & Phenotyping, and In Situ Sequencing. These tools offered by the company offer a range of solutions for single-cell analysis, ready for tissue imaging, biomarker discovery, precision diagnostics, therapeutics, and life science research. Phenoveu technology allows for the co-detection of multiple protein biomarkers in the same tissue section. The Genotyping & Phenotyping technology allows for the co-detection of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) and protein in the same tissue section. The in situ Sequencing technology allows you to examine the location of target mRNA sequences along with changes in single base pair mutations at the tissue and single-cell level. The RNAveu technology allows for detection of mRNA expression in your sample with sub-micron level accuracy by using uniquely labeled fluorophore-tagged barcoded probes. Their miRNAveu technology allows for detection of target miRNA expression and can be combined with other technologies such as RNAveu and Phenoveu for elucidation of tumor micro-environment. The NanoVIP system offers automation of any slide-based automation to produce reliable, consistent results requiring few days of training with low skilled laboratory personnel. NanoVIP takes slides from post-sectioning all the way to imaging-ready. Know more about Omicsveu here: https://www.omicsveu.com
